ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity (white) pixels occupying the central lobe areas, contrasted against 20% low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the trailing margins and median hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white lobes; solid black pigmentation along the trailing edges (approx. 5-10% lobe width); dark mottled pixel distribution concentrated at the central median notch and extending toward the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 35 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal width of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire continuous trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks increases at the distal tips, corresponding to localized physical irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes, tapering to sharply pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters observed at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes; a single isolated circular dark spot is visible in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white surface of both lobes, primarily in vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface and concentrated barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
